description.zh:
数据的存储空间。默认为default。支持自定义，以便进行业务分组和避免路径冲突。

> eci-system为ECI保留空间，不可使用。
description.en:
The data storage bucket. The default value is default. You can specify a custom bucket to group services and prevent path conflicts.

> eci-system is a reserved bucket for ECI and cannot be used.

description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见[如何保证幂等性](~~25693~~)。
description.en: A client token. It is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate a token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

description.zh:
创建一个弹性公网IP（EIP）并绑定。
如果VPC没有配置NAT网关，可以绑定EIP，以便拉取公网数据。
description.en:
The parameters for creating and attaching an EIP.
If no NAT gateway is configured for the VPC, you can attach an EIP to pull data from the Internet.

description.zh:
绑定已有的弹性公网IP（EIP）。
如果VPC没有配置NAT网关，可以绑定EIP，以便拉取公网数据。
description.en:
The ID of an existing elastic IP address (EIP) to be attached.
If no NAT gateway is configured for the VPC, you can attach an EIP to pull data from the Internet.
The name of the data cache.
The path where the data is stored.

description.zh: 保留天数。过期会被清理。默认不过期。
description.en: The number of days to retain the data cache. The data cache is cleared after it expires. By default, the data cache never expires.

description.zh: 创建数据缓存过程中生成的ECI实例所属的安全组ID。
description.en: The ID of the security group for the ECI instance that is generated during the data cache creation process.

description.zh: 数据缓存大小。单位为GiB，默认为20 GiB。请根据实际数据量评估所需大小。
description.en: The size of the data cache. Unit: GiB. The default value is 20 GiB. Evaluate the required size based on the actual amount of data.

description.zh: 数据缓存绑定的标签列表。
description.en: The list of tags to attach to the data cache.

description.zh: 创建数据缓存过程中生成的ECI实例所属的交换机ID。
description.en: The ID of the vSwitch for the ECI instance that is generated during the data cache creation process.

descriptions.zh:
- 创建镜像缓存涉及资源计费。建议您提前了解相关计费信息。更多信息，请参见[数据缓存计费](~~2503093~~)。
- 创建镜像缓存前，您需要评估待缓存数据的大小，如果数据大小超过设置的缓存大小，将会创建失败。
- 创建数据缓存时，系统将自动创建一个ECI实例和一块ESSD云盘用于中转创建数据缓存。创建过程中请勿删除ECI实例和云盘，否则数据缓存将创建失败。
- 创建数据缓存将生成对应的快照。请勿删除快照，否则数据缓存将会失效。
descriptions.en:
- Creating a data cache is a billable operation. Review the billing information before you proceed. For more information, see [Data cache billing](~~2503093~~).

- Before you create a data cache, evaluate the size of the data to be cached. If the data size exceeds the specified cache size, the creation will fail.

- When you create a data cache, the system automatically creates an ECI instance and an ESSD disk. Do not delete the ECI instance or the disk during this process. Otherwise, the data cache creation will fail.

- Creating a data cache generates a corresponding snapshot. Do not delete the snapshot. Otherwise, the data cache will become invalid.
